roadmapTask: Server recovers from runs left STARTED after a crash: add a test that kills the Server mid-run and shows the next scheduled tick is skipped, turn on Dagster run monitoring (plus a startup sweep only if monitoring alone doesn't clear the run), send a webhook alert when a stale run is cleared, and prove it with the Server E2E on both Postgres and DuckDB Warehouses. Keep it to 2–3 phases, before the ADR-0015 Git-based Breaking Change work.

phases.notes: already dirty at start: docs/roadmaps/agentic-dataops/{MAP,blockers,decisions,discoveries,state}.md and the horizon-12 roadmap .json/.md (planning output) | Changed: tests/e2e/test_server.py (+ discoveries.md line). Adds test_crash_leaves_stale_run_and_skips_next_tick: holds the stage Warehouse lock before the Server starts (Postgres pg_advisory_lock from the test; DuckDB flock from a helper container, see amendment), waits for STARTED, SIGKILLs both Server services, frees the lock, restarts, asserts the next post-restart tick is SKIPPED with Pipeline shop_sync is still running and the run is still STARTED.

amendments.reason: On macOS Docker Desktop a host-process fcntl.flock on the bind-mounted .lock file is not visible inside the Server container (verified: host lock -> container acquires; container lock -> second container blocked). Holding the DuckDB lock from a helper container started by the test keeps the same goal (the test holds the Warehouse lock so the run stays STARTED) and works on macOS and Linux CI.

changes.before: For DuckDB, take fcntl.flock on the <warehouse file>.lock path next to the DuckDB file in the Project folder.
changes.after: For DuckDB, start a detached helper container from the Server image with the Project bind-mounted at /project that takes fcntl.flock on /project/<warehouse file>.lock and sleeps; release by removing the container (its process exit drops the flock).
